title: Simplify Access admin for groups and job roles
summary: Super Admins now manage Cloudron group mappings, job-role capability packs, and the permission catalogue from a single Access workspace instead of three separate admin pages.
changes: Replace Super Admin Groups, Roles, and Permissions with one /admin/access workspace (Groups, Job roles, Permission catalogue tabs).
Add reviewed job-role capability packs with Advanced fine-grained permissions for custom and default job roles.
Redirect legacy /admin/groups, /admin/roles, and /admin/permissions URLs into the matching Access tab while keeping immutable mappings and denial audits unchanged.
version_rationale: Minor release: consolidates authorization admin UX into one workspace with capability packs without changing protected tiers, sync semantics, or mutation services.
validation: PHPUnit covers JobRoleCapabilityPacks, AdminAccessWorkspaceTest, updated Admin directory and role management suites, and authorization gate regressions.
Legacy admin URLs redirect into Access tabs; denial audits target admin.access.* routes.
Job-role Advanced permissions stay collapsed by default so capability packs are the primary editor.
known_limitations: Capability pack toggles use progressive enhancement; without JavaScript, job-role permissions are edited through Advanced checkboxes only.
Protected access-tier roles remain hidden from the Job roles editor.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. Legacy Groups, Roles, and Permissions routes return; Access workspace routes are removed.
provenance: Defined by the Access admin UX story for MyAPES Account issue #97 under epic #91 and pull request #120.
